entries.description: Most Cambodians consider themselves to be Khmers
entries.subject: Most Cambodians

spans.text: ### Background Most Cambodians consider themselves to be Khmers, descendants of the Angkor Empire that extended over much of Southeast Asia and reached its zenith between the 10th and 13th centuries.
Attacks by the Thai and Cham (from present-day Vietnam) weakened the empire, ushering in a long period of decline.
At least 1.5 million Cambodians died from execution, forced hardships, or starvation during the Khmer Rouge regime under POL POT.

entries.task_id: paris agreements|ended|the country’s civil war and mandated democratic elections
entries.description: Paris Agreements ended the country’s civil war and mandated democratic elections
entries.subject: Paris Agreements
entries.object: the country’s civil war and mandated democratic elections

spans.text: The 1991 Paris Agreements ended the country’s civil war and mandated democratic elections, which took place in 1993 and ushered in a period of multi-party democracy with a constitutional monarchy.

entries.task_id: norodom sihanouk|was|reinstated as head of state
entries.description: Norodom SIHANOUK was reinstated as head of state
entries.subject: Norodom SIHANOUK

spans.text: King Norodom SIHANOUK was reinstated as head of state, and the Cambodian People's Party (CPP) and the royalist FUNCINPEC party formed a coalition government.

entries.task_id: hun sen|dissolved|the coalition and sidelined funcinpec
entries.description: HUN SEN dissolved the coalition and sidelined FUNCINPEC
entries.subject: HUN SEN

spans.text: Nevertheless, the power-sharing arrangement proved fractious and fragile, and in 1997, a coup led by CPP leader and former PRK prime minister HUN SEN dissolved the coalition and sidelined FUNCINPEC.

entries.task_id: the cpp|has|since remained in power through elections criticized for lacking fairness
entries.description: the CPP has since remained in power through elections criticized for lacking fairness
entries.subject: the CPP
entries.object: since remained in power through elections criticized for lacking fairness

spans.text: Despite further attempts at coalition governance, the CPP has since remained in power through elections criticized for lacking fairness, political and judicial corruption, media control, and influence over labor unions, all of which have been enforced with violence and intimidation.

entries.description: HUN SEN remained as prime minister until 2023
entries.subject: HUN SEN

spans.text: HUN SEN remained as prime minister until 2023, when he transferred power to his son, HUN MANET.

spans.text: The CPP has also placed limits on civil society, press freedom, and freedom of expression.

Despite some economic growth and considerable investment from China over the past decade, Cambodia remains one of East Asia's poorest countries.

The remaining elements of the Khmer Rouge surrendered in 1999.
